xerjoff erba pura — eau de parfum en spr.description: Launched by luxe Italian label in 2019, Xerjoff Erba Pura is a fruity sweet citrus oriental fragrance enhanced by elements of powdery musk, vanilla and clean spice. The scent opens breathless and uplifting, mingling Calabrian bergamot with tart-sweet tones of Sicilian lemon and mandarin. Tantalizing citrus mellows to a blended fruit expression at the heart, followed by a sensual and serene finish of amber, irresistible Madagascar vanilla and shimmering white musk.
